description: Bayesian market module: conjugate normal-normal update of each category's expected return
units: Annual rates as decimals; prior_mean_sd is the prior standard deviation of the expected return mu (not of the returns)
design_choice: Prior means are the Annex A mu values; prior_mean_sd expresses how uncertain we are about each Annex A mu (wider for equity, tight for deposits). Chosen by the team, not estimated.
